subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct option is: **brought.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context tells us that the same voice that made everything come to life at once also pulled them into a deeper, otherwise hidden world that seemed to go on forever.
 
• The word** "brought" **fits the blank because it conveys the idea of causing something to come into a new state, aligning with the passage's description of the voice causing everything to come to life.
 
• The voice is described as stirring and enlivening the scene, and "brought" appropriately indicates this effect.

Hence, the correct answer is: **brought**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Transacted (व्यवाहारिक):** This means to carry out or conduct a business deal or exchange. It doesn't fit here, as the context is not about business transactions but about the impact of the voice on the scene.
 
• **Chiselled (कुंदल):** This means carved or shaped, often used for stone or wood. It doesn't fit the context of a voice impacting the scene, as it suggests physical alteration rather than emotional or atmospheric change.
 
• **Lightened (हल्का होना):** This means to make something less dark or heavy. While it might fit in some contexts, it doesn't capture the full effect described in the passage, which is more about awakening or bringing to life the scene.

 

The cloze test is given below:

Presently, a soprano voice of richness and depth floated from the open windows of the parlour, resonating *over __*the darkening greenery. All at once it was as if the entire scene before them was *__awakened __*by that voice, infused with unexpected life; the western sky, streaked with bands of pale gold and purple; the two houses, standing grey and disconsolate against that sky; the __*branches *__of trees casting deep black shadows here and there across the ground. The same voice that __***brought ***__everything suddenly to life also drew them into another, much deeper world: a world that was normally hidden, a world that (5) ..... into eternity.
